rapido.name: Quick
rapido.desc: Temp files, thumbnails, error reports, browser caches and the Recycle Bin. Safe for anyone.

programador.name: Developer
programador.desc: Everything in Quick plus pip/uv/npm/pnpm/cargo/gradle/NuGet/Go caches, editors, project artifacts (node_modules, target, __pycache__) and AI models.

ia.name: AI / ML
ia.desc: Downloaded models (Ollama, Hugging Face, LM Studio, Torch) and Python caches.

gamer.name: Gamer
gamer.desc: Quick + shader caches, Delivery Optimization and Windows Update downloads.

profundo.name: Deep
profundo.desc: Every module. Review the moderate and advanced items before cleaning.

user_temp.name: User temp files
user_temp.desc: Files in %TEMP% older than 24 h. Recent ones are kept in case an install is running.

thumbnails.name: Thumbnails
thumbnails.desc: File Explorer thumbnail cache (thumbcache_*.db). Rebuilt as you browse folders.

detail.thumbcache: File Explorer locks some of them; those are skipped.

wer.name: Error reports
wer.desc: Windows Error Reporting files (app crashes) already sent or queued.

crash_dumps.name: Memory dumps
crash_dumps.desc: Dumps created when an app or Windows crashes. Only useful for debugging.

windows_logs.name: Windows logs
windows_logs.desc: Files in C:\Windows\Logs older than 7 days (CBS, DISM, WindowsUpdate…).

shader_cache.name: Shader caches
shader_cache.desc: Compiled shaders from DirectX and NVIDIA/AMD/Intel drivers. Rebuilt while gaming (may stutter the first time).

detail.steam: Steam downloads or compiles them again when each game starts.

delivery_optimization.name: Delivery Optimization
delivery_optimization.desc: Peer-to-peer cache for Windows and Store updates.

detail.download: If an update is in progress its files are in use and will be skipped.

recycle_bin.name: Recycle Bin
recycle_bin.desc: Empties the Recycle Bin on every drive. Whatever is inside is permanently deleted.

chromium.desc: Web, code and GPU cache of every profile.
chromium.service_workers_detail: Offline data of sites and PWAs; downloaded again when you visit them.

firefox.name: Mozilla Firefox
firefox.desc: Web cache (cache2), startupCache and thumbnails of every profile.

pip.name: pip cache
pip.desc: Packages downloaded by pip (wheels and http). Same as `pip cache purge`.

uv.name: uv cache
uv.desc: uv (Astral) cache. Existing environments keep working.

poetry.name: Poetry cache
poetry.desc: Packages and artifacts downloaded by Poetry.

conda.name: conda packages
conda.desc: Tarballs (.conda/.tar.bz2) already extracted in pkgs. Same as `conda clean --tarballs`.

npm.name: npm cache
npm.desc: npm cache (_cacache, _npx, _logs). Same as `npm cache clean --force`.

pnpm.name: pnpm store
pnpm.desc: pnpm content-addressable store. Existing node_modules keep working (hard links).

detail.store: After cleaning, pnpm downloads packages again on install.

yarn.name: Yarn cache
yarn.desc: Yarn classic and Yarn Berry cache.

cargo.name: Cargo cache
cargo.desc: Downloaded and extracted crates (registry/cache, registry/src, git/checkouts).

detail.registry: Downloaded again on the next build (won't work offline).

gradle.name: Gradle caches
gradle.desc: Dependencies, wrapper distributions and daemon logs.

nuget.name: NuGet caches
nuget.desc: NuGet global packages and HTTP caches. Same as `dotnet nuget locals all --clear`.

editors.name: Editor caches
editors.desc: VS Code, Cursor, VSCodium and Windsurf: caches, downloaded VSIX files and logs. Extensions and settings are not touched.

jetbrains.name: JetBrains caches
jetbrains.desc: Caches and indexes of IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm, Rider… (re-indexed on next open).

projects.name: Project artifacts
projects.desc: node_modules, Cargo target, __pycache__, .venv and web framework caches inside your project folders. Rebuilt with npm install / cargo build / etc.

ollama.name: Ollama models
ollama.desc: Each model downloaded with `ollama pull`. Layers shared with other models are kept.

huggingface.name: Hugging Face
huggingface.desc: Models and datasets from the Hugging Face hub (transformers, diffusers, hf download…), one by one.

lmstudio.name: LM Studio models
lmstudio.desc: GGUF/MLX models downloaded in LM Studio, one by one.

misc.name: Other AI caches
misc.desc: Torch Hub checkpoints, Whisper and Keras models.

core.app_running: {name} is open ({exe}): close it to free everything; files in use will be skipped.
core.mode_exists: mode '{id}' already exists; change its id
core.mode_bad_id: invalid id: use lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_'
core.mode_incomplete: a mode needs a name and at least one module

error.protected: protected path, it can't be cleaned: {path}

protect.hiberfil: Hibernation file. Windows uses it for hibernation and Fast Startup. To free it, run `powercfg /h off` as administrator.
protect.pagefile: Windows virtual memory. Change its size in Settings → System → About → Advanced system settings → Performance.
protect.swapfile: Virtual memory Windows uses for apps. It is managed together with pagefile.sys.
protect.registry: Part of your user registry. Deleting it would break your Windows account.
protect.recycle_bin: Recycle Bin. Empty it from Cleanup instead.
protect.restore: Restore points and system data. Managed by Windows (System Protection).
protect.windows_old: Previous Windows or update files. Remove them from Settings → System → Storage → Temporary files.
protect.installed: Belongs to Windows or an installed program. Uninstall the program instead.
protect.drive_root: Top-level item of a drive. Open it and choose what's inside.
protect.base_folder: Base folder of a user profile or of Windows apps. Open it and choose what's inside.
protect.system_file: Windows marks this as a system file.

app.stale_scan: Some items no longer exist; analyze again.
app.system_path: {path} belongs to the system or an installed program
app.no_permission: No permission to read that folder
app.no_analysis: There is no analysis; analyze again.
app.item_gone: An item no longer exists; analyze again.
app.pick_existing_folder: Choose at least one folder that exists
app.no_search: There is no search; search again.
app.file_gone: A file is no longer in the list
app.keep_one_copy: Keep at least one copy of every file

admin.label: Admin
admin.confirm: RCleaner will restart as administrator so it can clean system folders. Continue?

clean.title: Cleanup
clean.lead: Temp files, caches and leftovers you don't need. Analyzing never deletes anything.
clean.progress: {done} of {total} modules · tap the circle to stop
clean.skipped_one: {n} file was in use or not accessible and was left alone.
clean.skipped_other: {n} files were in use or not accessible and were left alone.
clean.needs_admin: Some items need administrator rights (Admin button in the menu).

confirm.title: Clean {size}?
confirm.text_one: {n} item will be deleted. This can't be undone.
confirm.text_other: {n} items will be deleted. This can't be undone.

space.title: Space
space.lead: See what fills your disk, folder by folder. Nothing is deleted unless you choose it.
space.pick: Add to the list to delete
space.types_note: The whole analyzed drive, by file type.
space.confirm_text: You can restore it from the Recycle Bin. If something doesn't fit in it, Windows will warn you before deleting it.

dupes.title: Duplicates
dupes.lead: Find exact copies of your files. They are compared by content, not by name.
dupes.cloud_skipped_one: {n} cloud file without a local copy was not checked
dupes.cloud_skipped_other: {n} cloud files without a local copy were not checked
dupes.confirm_title_one: Move {n} copy to the Recycle Bin?
dupes.confirm_title_other: Move {n} copies to the Recycle Bin?
dupes.confirm_text: You'll free {size}. At least one copy of every file is kept, and you can restore what you delete from the Recycle Bin.

mode_editor.name: Name
mode_editor.desc_ph: What it cleans and when to use it
mode_editor.err_id: The name needs letters or digits.

settings.language_hint: Missing yours? You can help translate RCleaner on GitHub.
settings.exclusions_hint: Folders RCleaner never analyzes or deletes, in any section.
settings.default_mode_hint: Used by “Quick clean” and selected on start.
settings.custom_modes_hint: Combine the modules you want. They are saved as TOML in the folder

cli.unknown_mode: unknown mode '{id}'. Run `rcl modes` to list them.
cli.some_need_admin: Some items need to be run as administrator.
cli.nothing: Nothing to clean with those criteria.
cli.dry_run: DRY RUN: {size} would be freed. Repeat with --yes to clean.
